scope: New v4 engineering validation; does not replace or repeat the frozen v3 four-estimator study. Historical failures, interruptions and unknown identity intervals remain unchanged.
seed_partition_policy: Development has already used seeds 0, 1 and 3. Formal v4 uses previously unexecuted held-out seeds 1000..1009, frozen before formal outcomes; development probes must not consume them. The same registered v4 seed is reused across classes/groups. PX4/Gazebo process seed remains registered_seed+1. Historical v3 paired seeds 0..9 remain a separate four-baseline study, with no paired v3-v4 claim.
gazebo_render_policy: Prospective Gazebo-process-only Mesa llvmpipe selection; record actual owned-process rendering libraries/environment. Historical auto/D3D12 trials retain their original renderer and exit failures. No silent auto override or cross-renderer performance pooling.
shutter_protocol: Successful close ACK starts the original minimum dwell plus 0.05 s render allowance. A finer scheduler reduces tick quantization; request/ACK intervals are not rendered occlusion truth. This is a changed v4 scheduling protocol, not a retrospective correction of v3.
magnetic_library_policy: Freeze the explicit installed-package Gazebo library registration for this ROS/Ubuntu environment, and match each trial's owned-process actual loaded ELF path/hash to it. Humble uses a separate config/gazebo_magnetic_runtime_humble22.json registration. Source-version agreement cannot stand in for matching a different distribution's binary. No runtime self-registration or automatic acceptance of an unexpected ELF.
magnetic_environment_policy: Use Gazebo ENU/gauss magnetic output with the pinned isolated PX4 FLU-to-FRD bridge patch. Freeze the verified source/dependency/ELF runtime manifest before a plan is created; verify actual startup log, binary and source binding for every trial. Gazebo and PX4 lookup tables remain different. No target GT or trajectory-fit correction. The historical v3 and coherent_wmm intervention evidence remain unchanged. The manifest does not yet exist until the real isolated build is verified; never fabricate it.

supervisor_status_timing.wall_check_clock: ROS-time control tick; no independent status steady timer

source_time_policy: Disable XRCE Agent wall-clock mapping before client startup only for this Gazebo simulation. Independently audit raw PX4, timing diagnostics and source-stamped adapted odometry, keeping callback receipt and recorder delivery distinct and retaining all clock-tail silence. Invalid domains/regressions or a locked vehicle-frame reset fail the trial even when online protection correctly rejects them. Source-clock evaluator PASS is necessary but does not establish navigation performance or flight success. Preserve original bounds and register numeric navigation gates only after development probes, before formal trials.
vehicle_uncertainty_policy: Propagate reported PX4 pose covariance into navigation measurement covariance, including attitude uncertainty. This prospective setting remains subject to development probes and does not change the original innovation/safety gates.

multi_target_crossing_profile.policy: One finite quintic lane exchange followed by forward travel in the exchanged lanes. The 18 s duration is the nearest whole second to 17.905 s, matching the previous first sinusoidal exchange's peak lateral speed. Actual paths and separation require independent GT evaluation. Historical Humble13 used periodic sinusoidal exchanges, retains its conservative HOLD/performance failures, and is not pooled or paired with this prospective task revision. All full-interval navigation, physical identity, safety and final-settling gates remain unchanged; this task revision is not an online occlusion-geometry improvement.

takeoff_policy: PX4 NAV_TAKEOFF and ARM precede Offboard; startup must observe AUTO_LOITER, final magnetic/yaw alignment, healthy same-instance VLP/odometry and settled pose before REQUEST_OFFBOARD. MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT=3, COM_TAKEOFF_ACT=0 and SENS_IMU_MODE=1 are explicit pre-rcS overrides. An independent recorded-command/mode/readiness native_startup evaluator must pass; online readiness helper replay is not independent evidence. Resets after Offboard locking still hold the mission under the original frame-guard contract.

navigation_acceptance.note: Evidence completeness and process exit zero are not PASS. Formal freeze and execution are prohibited until valid numeric base_link distance/height RMSE limits, minimum navigation/truth/full-task physical identity coverage and the explicit final-settling requirement are REGISTERED. Development probes may remain EVALUATION_PENDING until these gates are chosen; the final complete 2-class x 6-group development matrix must then independently pass the registered gates before any held-out formal seed is consumed. No numeric performance gates are selected after seeing formal results. Physical identity coverage uses fixed 0.1 s time cells from the first REQUEST through the full recorded clock end, including silent tails, unconfirmed requests and unknown cells.

failure_policy: One simulator at a time. A trial is attempted once. Terminal records, failures and interrupted attempts are immutable. Resume consumes only PENDING slots. Infrastructure failures stop continuation and require a separately recorded diagnosis before any further pending slot; they never authorize a retry.
identity_policy: Initial middle box selection for multi-target conditions; hybrid_3d association; no nearest/confidence fallback and no full ReID. The acceptance denominator is fixed 10 Hz REQUEST-to-full-recorded-clock time, retaining unknown/unobserved tails. Legacy diagnostic-frame coverage remains diagnostic. Any observed wrong physical actor in either evidence stream fails; an unconfirmed requested task fails. Every task is independently mapped from its REQUEST box at source image time. A schema-v2 development gate must bind immutable probe plans/terminal records and actual reports for all 2 classes x 6 groups, flight-critical source/model/runtime hashes and separately identified offline evaluator hashes.

offline_selected_identity_visibility.policy: Keep the unique image IoU>=0.5 match, fully-in-frame extent, freshness, shutter guards and fixed REQUEST-to-full-clock identity denominator. For positive same-class GT-box overlap only, an additional sufficient certificate requires all three declared actors and complete rigid static render meshes, audited closed-scene assets, exact-source vehicle/actor geometry and exact physical camera/base geometry for a gimbal recording. Every overlapping other actor must have its whole-mesh optical-z minimum strictly greater than the chosen actor's whole-mesh maximum plus 0.05 m. Missing/unsupported geometry, near-plane crossings, multiple feasible image matches or overlapping depth bands remain UNKNOWN. This offline-only rule never chooses an online identity, supplies a runtime measurement, establishes YOLO box completeness, changes the MOT visible subset or removes unknown time cells. Freeze its evaluator and asset provenance before formal outcomes; preserve historical reports and failures.

comparison_policy: Report all 120 slots and all failures. Pair v4 classes/groups by the same held-out registered seed 1000..1009 where applicable. Active/midpoint visual improvements do not replace base_link physical following errors. Historical v3 uses paired seeds 0..9 for its separate four-baseline study; these v4 trials are not paired reruns of v3 and do not repeat that estimator comparison.
